name: Cerlapirdine
summary: Cerlapirdine (USAN; SAM-531, WAY-262,531, PF-05212365) is a drug which was under development by Wyeth/Pfizer for the treatment of cognitive disorders associated with Alzheimer's disease and schizophrenia. In a phase II clinical trial it demonstrated a trend toward efficacy along with a good side effect profile and no incidence of serious adverse events, but no further development has occurred since 2011.

pharmacology.text: It exerts its effects by acting as a selective 5-HT6 receptor antagonist.

uses.text: Cerlapirdine (USAN; SAM-531, WAY-262,531, PF-05212365) is a drug which was under development by Wyeth/Pfizer for the treatment of cognitive disorders associated with Alzheimer's disease and schizophrenia. In a phase II clinical trial it demonstrated a trend toward efficacy along with a good side effect profile and no incidence of serious adverse events, but no further development has occurred since 2011.

fact.en: The 5-HT6 receptor it blocks is found almost only in the brain, which made it an attractive target for memory drugs. Several drugs of this type reached late trials, but none has yet been approved.
fact.zh: 它所阻斷的 5-HT6 受體幾乎只存在於大腦中，因此成為記憶藥物的熱門目標。這類藥物已有好幾種進入後期試驗，但至今沒有一種獲得核准。
fact.zhHans: 它所阻断的 5-HT6 受体几乎只存在于大脑中，因此成为记忆药物的热门目标。这类药物已有好几种进入后期试验，但至今没有一种获得核准。
